mercenary_privilege.name: Increased Pay
mercenary_privilege.description: Increase the revenue of your mercenary contract by 5% per level.

mercenary_privilege.name: Workshop Grant
mercenary_privilege.description: Acquire a workshop property. The property will be situated in one of the towns of your contractor.

mercenary_privilege.name: Estate Grant
mercenary_privilege.description: Acquire an estate property. The property will be situated in one of the villages of your contractor.

mercenary_privilege.name: Mercenary Levy
mercenary_privilege.description: Stablish a mercenary levy (tier III) troop for your company. A custrom troop is designable and will only be available for your clan, in towns of the kingdom associated with the career they were designed.

mercenary_privilege.name: Mercenary Professional
mercenary_privilege.description: Stablish a mercenary professional (tier V) troop for your company. A custrom troop is designable and will only be available for your clan, in towns of the kingdom associated with the career they were designed.

mercenary_privilege.name: Barony Grant
mercenary_privilege.description: Become landed in the fashion of a lord. Request a castle alongside it's barony-level title. The settlement ownership will not undo your mercenary contract.

mercenary_privilege.name: Full Peerage
mercenary_privilege.description: For your extraordinary service, have your clan considered a full Peer. While the Peerage won't be effective until you leave your mercenary life behind, you will be able to join kingdoms as the elite of the nobility, rather than a lesser Peer.
